note: 20 English outlets with public RSS and server-rendered article HTML (no hard paywall / JS-only pages), chosen by a fetch+extract probe on 2026-11-24. Spares that also worked: Engadget, Times of India, ABC News (US). Rejected: Sky News, The Hill, Politico, Axios (HTTP 403 to crawlers), CNN (feed 500), CBC (feed timeout), PBS (0 paragraphs), The Independent (empty feed), CBS (many video-only items).
